item.title: Unnao rape: HC refuses to suspend sentence of Sengar in custodial death case of victim's father
item.description: On March 13, 2020, Sengar was sentenced to 10 years rigorous imprisonment by the trial court, besides imposition of a fine of Rs 10 lakh, in the case of the death of the survivor's father in custody. The trial court had said "no leniency" could be shown for killing a family's "sole bread earner".

item.title: Novak Djokovic vs Pedro Martinez Live score: Serbian legend to begin quest for record 25th Slam
item.description: Novak Djokovic vs Pedro Martinez Live: Serbian legend Novak Djokovic begins his quest for a record 25th Grand Slam as he makes his 21st appearance at the Australian Open 2026. Djokovic will be facing Pedro Martinez in his first round in Melbourne and will look to make light work of his opponent.

item.title: Kishtwar encounter: Paratrooper succumbs to injuries as search operation enters day 2 in J-K
item.description: Kishtwar encounter: The encounter broke out in the Sonnar village near Mandral-Singhpora in the Chatroo belt on Sunday after specific inputs about some terrorists of Jaish-e-Mohammed (JeM) in the area.

item.title: 'I'd be keen to do that': Steve Smith outlines his future goals with Australia
item.description: Veteran Australia batter Steve Smith, on the back of some stellar performances in the ongoing BBL (Big Bash League) took centre stage and outlined his future goals with Australia with the T20 World Cup 2026.

item.title: WhatsApp GIFs are changing: New provider and bigger GIF grid spotted
item.description: WhatsApp is set to change how users share GIFs from July 2026 as it replaces Tenor with Klipy. The update also introduces a larger GIF keyboard layout for faster searches.

item.title: Bengal SIR: SC orders EC to display names of 1.25 crore voters on 'logical discrepancies' list
item.description: To make this process easier, the court ordered that facilities for submitting documents and objections should be set up within panchayat bhavans and block offices. It also directed the West Bengal government to provide sufficient staff to assist the State Election Commission during this exercise.

item.title: IMF raises India's FY26 growth forecast to 7.3% despite global tariff uncertainty
item.description: For calendar years 2026 and 2027, the International Monetary Fund forecast growth of 6.3 per cent and 6.5 per cent, respectively.

item.title: When will Mumbai get its mayor? Reservation lottery to be held on Thursday
item.description: The draw will determine which category the Mayor’s post of BMC will be reserved for, not just in Mumbai but across 29 municipal corporations in Maharashtra.

item.title: Ever dreamed of sending your name to the Moon? NASA’s Artemis II makes it possible
item.description: NASA is inviting people worldwide to send their names to the Moon aboard the Artemis II mission. Learn how to get an Artemis II boarding pass before the first crewed lunar flight in over 50 years.
